coverage.scope: Carnegie Mellon Pittsburgh main undergraduate catalog; Qatar excluded
coverage.method: {"pages": 1, "directory_entries": 194, "pagination": "All A-Z entries in one static catalog HTML, no further page links"}
coverage.exclusions: Keep named bachelor degrees, splitting BA/BS alternatives. Keep additional majors with explicit non-standalone route; exclude all minors and Qatar items. Additional majors are not standalone degrees.
gaps: Some joint programs are listed with mirrored names by administering departments (Economics/Mathematical Sciences; Biological Sciences/Psychology); raw identifiers and URLs preserve these distinct catalog listings.
Additional majors must not be described as independent bachelor degrees.
